name: Dark Link
description: Dark Link prototype with corrected albedo sampler lookup for black body/red eyes, plus on-screen diagnostics. In-game appearance requires verification.

options.name: Appearance diagnostics
options.description: Show four diagnostic lines for the incomplete black-body/red-eye effect. Resets when enabled or transforming; no log file needed.

options.name: Duration (seconds)
options.description: Paused in menus and cutscenes. A duration change applies to the next transformation.

options.name: Sword damage (%)
options.description: 100% is normal damage; 200% doubles native sword damage. Native signed damage is capped at 127.

options.name: Free transformation
options.description: Transform without charging and stay transformed until toggled off. Useful for testing the appearance.

options.name: Touch button X
options.description: Horizontal position on the centered 1280 x 720 canvas.

options.name: Touch button Y
options.description: Vertical position on the centered 1280 x 720 canvas.
